art_direction: 柔雾蓝底，左眼先睁开，双眼略分开左望，好奇心突然被勾起。
composition_variation: Use similar-sized eyes but lift the left lid more while right stays relaxed. Widen the spacing and turn both pupils left. Make left lower contour rounder, right shallower, retaining hand-painted edges. The emotion is sudden intelligent interest rather than silly astonishment. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
